"within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data"

reasons: The Agreement was silent on exit; a single concise new Section 4.3 supplies all preferred elements: up-to-six-month assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in standard machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification.

The return deadline runs from the Termination Date, not from a Customer request; the "at the Company's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance and does not swallow the mandatory data-return, deletion or certification duties.

No existing term was altered and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced; "Termination Date" is an already-defined term and "Content, user information and customer data" tracks the hosting subject matter.
